purpose: Teach: 断固/刻ま/在学/将校/忠誠/一変/苦難/体格

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の不正、当社、断固として、許さない方針、社員、徹底させろ、絶対、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: We will not tolerate fraud in this industry. Make absolutely sure every staff member understands this policy. I'm serious.
lines.style: Steady, authoritative opening. Clipped cadence on the three core points. No flourish — each sentence lands like a directive. Composed but unmistakably firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業者の言葉、社員の心に、刻まれております、本当に、感謝、しております、絶対、引き継ぎます、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. The founder's words are carved into our staff's hearts. We're truly grateful for that legacy, and we will absolutely carry it forward with full commitment.
lines.style: Formal respect, but not stiff. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on gratitude and inheritance — these are the connective tissues he's affirming. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: インターン、まだ、在学中の学生、若い才能、本気で、採用していけ、当社の未来、絶対だ、本気で、頼む、絶対。
lines.en: We need to keep recruiting young talent — interns still in school, people with potential. Our company's future depends on it. I mean this.
lines.style: Shift to directive mode. Slightly faster pace. The phrase about future carries weight — it's not a wish, it's a principle. Lean forward slightly on the final sentence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。元自衛隊将校の社員、本当に、頼もしい存在、なっております、社内、本気で、活躍、目立っております、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We have a former JSDF officer on staff who's become a genuinely reassuring presence. He's standing out and making a real difference already.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment underneath the formality. Slight brightness when mentioning the officer's performance — this is genuine recognition. Not gushing, but genuinely pleased.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の忠誠心、本気で、感謝、しております、私からも、絶対、応えてまいります、本当に、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気。
lines.en: I want you to know how much I appreciate your staff's loyalty. I won't forget it. I'll do everything I can to honour that commitment.
lines.style: More personal register now, though still composed. Slower pace. The gratitude is real — let it settle. Closing line is a quiet promise, not a performance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の経営方針、市場の変化で、一変、する可能性、ありますが、芯は、絶対、守ってまいります、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. Our management direction may shift as the market changes, but the core of who we are — that we'll protect absolutely. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Thoughtful but firm. Acknowledge the reality of market pressure with a slight hesitation, then pivot to the unchangeable principle with quiet conviction. Not defensive.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時の苦難、社員、本気で、知って欲しい、絶対、若手にも、伝えていけ、本当に、頼んだぞ、絶対、これは。
lines.en: I need the younger staff to understand how hard those early years were. Make sure they know. It matters that they know where we came from.
lines.style: Slower tempo, more weight. This is legacy-passing — treat it that way. The opening carries slight emotion, not despair but the weight of memory. Let the final sentence breathe.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、体格、お祝いの席で、お祖父ちゃんから、見るたびに、立派になったと、本気で、おっしゃってます、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. I've noticed — at company celebrations, our staff look more capable every time their grandfather sees them. He tells them so, seriously. It matters to all of us.
lines.style: Gentle warmth here. Personal anecdote, not business report. Slightly slower, more conversational. The mention of the grandfather carries quiet affection. Close with genuine feeling.
